title: XGBoost model predicts in-hospital mortality in ICU patients with diabetic kidney disease
summary: An XGBoost model, the best of eight algorithms with LASSO feature selection, was developed on 3,403 ICU patients with diabetic kidney disease from MIMIC-IV (AUROC 0.738 internally) and externally validated on 260 patients at the First Affiliated Hospital of Yangtze University (AUROC 0.746, accuracy 72.69%). Discrimination is modest, the external cohort is small and no comparator score is reported.
ai_technology: XGBoost (best of eight algorithms, LASSO feature selection) predicting in-hospital mortality in ICU diabetic kidney disease
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Yangtze University

evidence.tested: Retrospective external validation cohort of 260 patients (YTU-ICU) after development on MIMIC-IV.
evidence.unknown: Comparison with existing scores, prospective performance and clinical benefit; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A gradient boosting model predicted in-hospital mortality from ICU data.
